convert_checkpoint_wav2vec2_bert: convert a wav2vec2 seamless checkpoint to a HuggingFace Wav2Vec2Bert model
load_conformer_shaw_model: load a conformer shaw model from a checkpoint path for wav2vec2 bert conversion
save_pretrained_wav2vec2_bert: save a converted wav2vec2 bert model and feature extractor to a local directory
push_to_hub_wav2vec2_bert: push a converted wav2vec2 bert model and feature extractor to a HuggingFace Hub repository
verify_model_conversion: verify that the original and converted wav2vec2 bert models produce matching outputs on audio input
